workouts.name: Barbell Back Squat
workouts.instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, bar on upper back. Lower until thighs are parallel to floor, then drive back up.

workouts.name: Leg Press
workouts.instructions: Sit on the machine, place feet on the platform hip-width apart. Push the platform away and slowly lower back down.

workouts.name: Romanian Deadlift
workouts.instructions: Hold weights in front of thighs, hinge at hips while keeping back straight, lower weights to mid-shin level, then return to standing.

workouts.name: Walking Lunges
workouts.instructions: Step forward with one leg, lower the back knee toward the floor, then step the back foot forward to continue walking.

workouts.name: Calf Raises
workouts.instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, raise up onto your toes as high as possible, then slowly lower back down.

workouts.name: Bicep Curl
workouts.instructions: Hold weights with palms facing up, curl the weights up toward your shoulders while keeping elbows close to your sides.

workouts.name: Tricep Dips
workouts.instructions: Grip bars with arms straight, lower your body by bending elbows until upper arms are parallel to floor, then press back up.

workouts.name: Hammer Curl
workouts.instructions: Hold dumbbells with palms facing inward (neutral grip), curl weights up while keeping elbows tucked, lower slowly.

workouts.name: Skull Crushers
workouts.instructions: Lie on bench holding bar above chest, lower the weight toward forehead by bending elbows, then extend arms back up.

workouts.name: Wrist Curls
workouts.instructions: Rest forearms on thighs or bench with palms up, curl the weight up using only your wrists, then lower slowly.

workouts.name: Bench Press
workouts.instructions: Lie on bench, grip bar slightly wider than shoulder-width, lower bar to chest, then press back up to starting position.

workouts.name: Deadlift
workouts.instructions: Stand over bar, grip it just outside legs, keep back flat and hips down, drive through heels to lift bar, lock hips at top.

workouts.name: Pull-Ups
workouts.instructions: Hang from bar with palms facing away, pull chest up to bar by driving elbows down, lower slowly back to hanging position.

workouts.name: Overhead Press
workouts.instructions: Hold bar at shoulder height, press it overhead until arms are fully extended, lower back to shoulders under control.

workouts.name: Dumbbell Row
workouts.instructions: Place one knee on bench, hold dumbbell in opposite hand, pull weight up toward hip while keeping back flat, lower slowly.

workouts.name: Chest Fly
workouts.instructions: Lie on bench with arms extended out to sides, bring weights together over chest in an arc, then slowly open back out.

workouts.name: Push-Ups
workouts.instructions: Start in plank position with hands shoulder-width apart, lower chest to floor by bending elbows, then push back up.

workouts.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
workouts.instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees, press dumbbells from shoulder level up until arms are fully extended, lower with control.

workouts.name: Plank
workouts.instructions: Support body on forearms and toes, keep body in a straight line from head to heels, hold position without letting hips drop.

workouts.name: Bicycle Crunches
workouts.instructions: Lie on back with hands behind head, bring opposite elbow to opposite knee in a cycling motion while extending the other leg.

workouts.name: Russian Twists
workouts.instructions: Sit with knees bent, lean back slightly, rotate torso side to side while holding weight or keeping hands together.

workouts.name: Hanging Leg Raises
workouts.instructions: Hang from bar with arms extended, raise legs up until they are parallel to the floor (or higher), lower slowly back down.

workouts.name: Lateral Raises
workouts.instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides, raise arms out to the sides until parallel with floor, then lower slowly back down.

workouts.name: Face Pulls
workouts.instructions: Set cable at face height, pull the rope toward your face while flaring elbows out, hold briefly, then return slowly.

workouts.name: Running
workouts.instructions: Maintain a steady pace with good posture, land midfoot, keep arms relaxed and swing naturally, breathe rhythmically.

workouts.name: Jump Rope
workouts.instructions: Hold handles at hip height, swing rope overhead and jump over it with both feet, land softly on balls of feet.

workouts.name: Burpees
workouts.instructions: Start standing, drop hands to floor, jump feet back to plank, do a push-up, jump feet to hands, then jump up with arms overhead.

workouts.name: Lat Pulldown
workouts.instructions: Sit at machine, grip bar wider than shoulder-width, pull bar down to upper chest while leaning slightly back, return slowly.

workouts.name: Seated Cable Row
workouts.instructions: Sit upright, grip the handle, pull it toward your lower chest while squeezing shoulder blades together, return with control.

workouts.name: Hip Thrust
workouts.instructions: Rest upper back on bench, roll barbell over hips, drive hips up until body forms a straight line, squeeze glutes at top.

metadata.description: A comprehensive workout database for a fitness app school project
metadata.note: Calories burned are estimates based on a 155 lb (70 kg) person. Actual values vary by body weight and intensity.
